claims.sentence: <jats:title>Summary</jats:title><jats:p>Data from the early stages of the thrombosis prevention trial (TPT) have been used to establish and quantify the risk of extracranial bleeding due to low dose aspirin (75 mg) and low intensity oral anticoagulation with warfarin (international normalised ratio, INR, 1.5) singly or in combination, in men aged between 45 and 69 who are at high risk of ischaemic heart disease (IHD).
